description: Applies a table you declare. It ships no table, and is not guidance from any audit firm or standard-setter. The sample size is only as defensible as the table. From a control frequency, a declared population size, a declared population hash, a period in days and a caller-supplied policy table keyed by frequency (expected population range and sample size per row), it returns the sample size from the matching row, whether the declared population falls inside the expected range for that frequency (a mismatch is flagged, never corrected), and a deterministic integer selection interval and start offset derived from the population hash. A missing table, a missing or duplicated frequency row, an invalid row or a sample size above the population is refused with an explicit code. No randomness and no clock. Values only, no personal data.
